artifacts.description: feat(core): delete a user parameter and change a parameter's unit

acceptance_criteria: `Document::delete_param(&mut self, name: &str) -> Result<(), ModelError>` removes a `ParamKind::User` parameter. An unknown name is `UnknownParameter`. A `ParamKind::Model` parameter is a new error `ModelError::ModelParameter(name)` (it belongs to its dimension). A parameter named by another parameter's expression or by a feature in the history (`FeatureKind::params`) is a new error `ModelError::ParameterInUse { param, used_by }`, where `used_by` lists the parameter names in table order and then the feature names in history order. On any error the document is unchanged.

`Document::set_param_unit(&mut self, name: &str, unit: &str) -> Result<(), ModelError>` changes the unit and keeps the physical quantity. A plain value is converted: 25.4 with `mm` set to `in` gives 1.0; 90 with `deg` set to `rad` gives π/2 (1e-12 relative). A parameter with an expression keeps the expression and is re-evaluated in the new unit. Dependent parameters keep their values (the d1/d2 example in Context).

`unit` must be empty or a suffix that `Unit::from_suffix` accepts, otherwise a new error `ModelError::InvalidUnit(unit)`. A unit of another dimension (for example `mm` to `deg`, or `mm` to empty) is `ModelError::ParameterDimension` with the old and new dimensions. An unknown name is `UnknownParameter`. On any error the document is unchanged.
Each new error variant has a `Display` message that names the parameter (and, for `ParameterInUse`, its users).

Unit tests in `swx-core` cover every case above, including: deleting an unused user parameter; refusing a model parameter; refusing one used by an expression and by a feature, with the exact `used_by` list; the three conversions in Context; `InvalidUnit` for `furlong`; `ParameterDimension` for `mm` to `deg`; and an unchanged document after each error (compare `parameters()` before and after).
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
